claims.allowed_copy: You can also type a query in traditional characters, such as 臺北到東京 10月 頭等.
limitations: Pending: 飛 on its own, the shortest way to write a route (香港飛東京, 臺北飛紐約), is not read in 1.0, and neither are 下禮拜 or 桃園 (below). A query written that way fails in the iPhone app while the same route in simplified characters (香港飞东京) is read (zh-hant.test.ts:263-269), so this sentence is not used on a public surface until the parser reads those forms or the sentence is approved with these limits.

Tested (packages/core/src/lib/query/zh-hant.test.ts): the place names 臺北, 台北, 東京, 倫敦, 紐約 and 香港 and the other Traditional aliases in packages/core/data/places.json; the cabins 頭等, 商務, 公務艙 and 經濟, with or without 艙; dates such as 10月, 下個月, 12月1日到12月15日, 12月1號, 未來兩週 and 下週; the direction words 到, 至, 往, 飛往, 前往, 從 and 由. 下個月, like 下个月, is read as the 30 days from today, not the calendar month, and 下週, like 下周, as the 7 days from today, not the calendar week (dates.ts:122, :134).

Not read in 1.0: 飛 on its own as a direction word (香港飛東京 names no destination, while 香港飛往東京 and 香港到東京 are read); 兩周 written with 周, 兩週之內 and 下禮拜; the spellings 伊斯坦堡, 伊斯坦布爾, 西貢, 休士頓, 蒙特利爾, 卡爾加里, 巴塞羅那 and 希思羅; 桃園, 松山, 高雄 and 澳門, which are not in the place list in either script; and 哩程 as a sort word (哩程最低 is not read, 里程最低 is; the sort defaults to the lowest miles either way). The iPhone app parses without an LLM (apps/ios/src/search/search.ts:165), so a query whose places or dates are not read is a parse failure that names the missing fields.
